knowledgeGaps.title: Uncalibrated High-Temperature Relative Permeability Curves
knowledgeGaps.documentedGap: Lack of multi-phase steam-oil-water relative permeability laboratory measurements at temperatures exceeding 250°C in Jodhpur Sandstone cores.
knowledgeGaps.impactOnSimulation: Thermal EOR recovery models must rely on modified Corey/Stone-2 correlation extrapolations above 250°C.

knowledgeGaps.title: Multi-Cycle Thermal Casing Fatigue Endurance Limits
knowledgeGaps.documentedGap: Empirical casing thread connection seal failure data beyond 3 consecutive CSS cycles at >320°C steam temperature is unavailable in public OIL field records.
knowledgeGaps.impactOnSimulation: Long-term casing stress and thermal elongation predictions carry elevated uncertainty after cycle 3.

knowledgeGaps.title: Sparse 3D Seismic Resolution on Eastern Margin Fault Blocks
knowledgeGaps.documentedGap: 2D seismic coverage (DD lines) provides structural outline of main anticlinal high but lacks high-resolution 3D fault throw mapping along eastern boundary faults.
knowledgeGaps.impactOnSimulation: Compartmentalization and fault-seal leakage risks cannot be ruled out during high-pressure steam injection.

knowledgeGaps.title: Extra-Heavy Crude Non-Newtonian Shear Thinning at Low Shear Rates
knowledgeGaps.documentedGap: Laboratory rheometer testing at 30°C and 15°C was conducted under constant shear rate, leaving low-shear static yield stress unmeasured.
knowledgeGaps.impactOnSimulation: Unheated wellbore static restart pressure gradient requires safety margin when computing SRP initial polished rod load.
